# Trophies and Prey Welfare
## Trophies Yautja are free to claim any body part of their prey, but are limited to a single item from the prey's inventory as a trophy, unless the prey is permakilled.
Yautja may use their own initiative when choosing what to claim. For example, a Yautja who started the hunt might only take an item, as they were the initiating party. If the prey attacked the Yautja first, they might take a limb instead, and if the same prey tries again later, their skull.
- Yautja cannot use any of their trophies, except for headgear and melee weapons. - Specialist weapons, smartguns, drones and any unique gear the specialist or smartgunner needs (such as the scout sight or specialist ammo) cannot be taken unless the prey is permakilled. - The same applies to IDs, for both regular and specialist marines. Info tags can still be taken.
## Welfare of prey You are forbidden from saving or healing anyone unless you're actively in combat with them. - If the other faction intervenes while you are actively engaged, you may save your prey and bring them to a safe location on the hunting grounds to continue the hunt. - If you breach the Honor Code while actively engaging prey, you may save them and return them to their defenses or faction. - You may heal prey you've killed, but not defibrillate them.
